summary: STEP 2 backend-only test pass: refactored activities to string values + rotating 4-week menu. 63/63 pytest tests passed (10 new tests added on top of the iteration_2 regression). Activities: new string shape ('Partecipato'/'Non ha Partecipato', 'Ha mangiato'/'Non ha mangiato'/'Ha mangiato poco', 'Si'/'No', notes) verified end-to-end. Old integer fields (umore, riposo_minuti, bagno_cambi) confirmed NO LONGER required nor present in API output. Idempotent upsert per (student_id,date) still works. Seeded Alice activity has didattica='Partecipato', motoria='Partecipato', pranzo='Ha mangiato', merenda='Si', riposo='Si', cacca='Si', pipi='Si'. AI report still produces Italian text mentioning 'partecipato'/'mangiato' from the new fields. Rotating menu: GET /menus returns meal_count=20 for 'Menu 2025/2026' (valid_from 2025-09-15, valid_to 2026-06-30, notes contain 'NOTA BENE'). The 20 meals match the user's MySQL dump (Sett 1 Lun = Pasta con legumi (lenticchie)/Prosciutto cotto/Insalata/Frutta fresca) and are ordered week 1..4 × Lunedi..Venerdi. POST /menus auto-creates 20 empty meal rows. PUT /menus/{id}/meals is idempotent (same payload twice keeps 20 rows). GET /menus/current returns {menu, current_week in 1..4, meals[5]} ordered Lun..Ven for admin AND parent. DELETE /menus/{id} cascades menu_meals (verified via /menus/{id}/meals returning placeholder rows with id=None). Role guards verified: parent gets 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE on menus & meals; teacher can POST + PUT meals but DELETE is admin-only. All 53 iteration_2 tests still green.

minor.issue: After deleting a menu, this endpoint still returns 20 placeholder cells (id=None) instead of 404. Not a bug — current contract is 'always fill the 4x5 grid' — but undocumented.
Pydantic model silently drops extra/old fields (umore, riposo_minuti, bagno_cambi) instead of 422. Acceptable for forward-compat migration but worth a comment.

minor.endpoint: Legacy WeeklyMenuIn model still defined in server.py but unused — dead code (carry-over from STEP 1).

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Remove unused WeeklyMenuIn model from server.py.
(Optional) GET /menus/{id}/meals for a non-existing menu_id returns 20 placeholder rows; consider 404 instead.

(Carry-over from iteration_2, still applicable) server.py is now even larger (~1700+ lines) - split into modules; scope generic list endpoints (communications, lesson-plans, extra-labs, calendar-events) by role; add duplicate-action guard on POST /attendance.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_current_week uses ISO Monday alignment via .weekday() - correct for rotating 4-week schedule. Returns (delta_weeks % 4)+1, range [1,4]. Verified.

PUT /menus/{id}/meals uses $set with a fresh gen_id() on every upsert — re-running the same payload changes the row's id field. Functionally harmless but means external clients caching by id will see id changes. Consider $setOnInsert for id.

GET /menus/current does NOT verify the menu_id of the menu_meals via index (no compound index on menu_id+week+day). Acceptable at this scale but add unique index if you want to enforce uniqueness at the DB level.
ActivityIn now all-strings: no enum/Literal validation on didattica/pranzo/etc. — a malformed value like 'foo' would be accepted. Consider Literal[...] for stricter API.
server.py still 1700+ lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; split into modules (auth, school, parents, activities, menus, communications, media, attendance, ai).
